stages.name: Street Car
stages.description: Production shell and factory layout. Simple three-step upgrades teach each category before the car becomes a dedicated race build.

stages.name: Street Race Car
stages.description: Stock body, gutted and caged, questionably street legal. Parts become named choices instead of a numbered ladder.

stages.name: Front-Half Race Car
stages.description: Front-half / tube-chassis work with serious chassis changes and physically compatible engine swaps.

stages.name: Full Race Car
stages.description: Full race-car construction with much wider powertrain and chassis freedom.
